units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:10">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>כשהייתי … והולך וסוֹבֵב כל וכ׳</he> when I travelled … and went around all the towns; <he>הייתי סובב והולך מעיר וכ׳</he> I went around from town to town.
<cite ref="Eruvin 56a:6">Erub. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>וסובב אל צפון בלילה</he> ‘and turns northward’ (<cite ref="Ecclesiastes 1:6">Koh. I, 6</cite>) by night; a. e.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>ונָסַבָּה ורחבה למעלה</he> it turned upward and became wider.

senses.gloss: to surround. Erub. l. c.; B. Bath. 25ᵇ (ref. to Koh. l. c.) פעמים מְסַבַּבְתָּן ופעמים מהלכתן (Rashi סוֹבַבְתָּן, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) at seasons the sun goes around them (making a circuitous route), and at seasons it passes straight through (from north-east to south-west).
units: Erub. 23ᵇ; Num. R. s. 13 סַבֵּב tie around; a. e.—Trnsf. to be around a person, to wait upon.
Deut. R. s. 1 (play on סב את ההר, Deut. II, 3) הרבה סי׳ עשו את הורו וכ׳ a long while has Esau been around his parent &c.—סי׳ על הפתחים to go around from door to door, to beg.

<cite ref="Tosefta Peah 4:8">Tosef. Peah IV, 8</cite> <he>המְסַבֵּב על … אין וכ׳</he> for the poor man that goes begging, the public charities are not bound to do anything. Y. ib. I, 15ᵈ top <he>כבד … אפי׳ את מסבב וכ׳</he> ‘honor thy father and thy mother’, even if thou have to go begging (thou must support them); <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 23:1">Pesik. R. s. 23—24</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah, Petichta 1">Ruth R. to I, 1</cite> <he>עכשיו … מְסַבְּבִין פתחי וכ׳</he> now all Israel will surround my gate …, waiting for distribution of food; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 598:1">Yalk. ib. 598</cite> <he>יהיו … מְסוּבִּין</he>.

senses.gloss: to carry around from place to place.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 1:7">Kel. I, 7</cite> <he>ומְסַבְּבִין לתוכן וכ׳</he> and you may carry a corpse from one (of the fortified places) to another; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 1:14">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. I, 14</cite> <he>ומס׳ בתוכן</he>.
Num. R. s. 2 סי׳ לכסאו וכ׳ he placed four angels around his throne.—Part. pass. מְסוּבָּב, f. מְסוּבֶּבֶת surrounded, closed.
B. Bath. 25ᵇ, v. אַכְסַדְרָא.—Pl. מְסוּבִּים, מְסוּבִּין assembled, arranged around.

Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ מס׳ לו וכ׳ (Ms. M. מְסוֹבְבִין אותו) (his sins) are arranged around him on the day of judgment (as witnesses). Yalk. Ruth l. c., v. supra.—Esp. reclining on the dining couch around the tables (v. מְסוּבֶּה).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 25">Ex. R. s. 25</cite> <he>מס׳ ואוכלין וכ׳</he> lying on couches and eating and praising &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 101b:6">Pes. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>בני … מס׳ לשתות</he> the members of a party that were assembled for a feast; <cite ref="Pesachim 102a:8">ib. 102ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 10:12">Tosef. ib. X, 12</cite>; a. fr.—[Tanḥ. Ḥayé 3 <he>מסביב</he>, read: <he>מכתיב</he>, v. <cite ref="K01339"><he>כָּתַב</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: [to surround the table,] to recline for dining in company.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 6:6">Ber. VI, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Berakhot 42a:10">42ᵃ</cite>) <he>הֵסֵיבּוּ אחד וכ׳</he> (Bab. ed. <he>הֵסֵבּוּ</he>; Y. ed. <he>הֵיסֵבּוּ</he>) if they lie down for a meal, one says grace in behalf of all, opp. <he>היו יושבין</he>. Tosef. ib. IV, 20 <he>בעל הבית שהיה מֵיסֵב ואוכל וכ׳</he> if a host has been reclining in company and eating, and a neighbor called him away to speak to him. Ib. V, 5; Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵃ bot. <he>בזמן שהן שתי … ומיסב וכ׳</he> when there are two couches, the highest in rank goes up and reclines at the head of the uppermost couch &c., v. <cite ref="E00695"><he>הֶסֵּב</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:1">Pes. X, 1</cite> <he>אפי׳ עני … עד שיֵסֵב</he> even the poorest man in Israel must not eat (on the Passover night) without reclining (to indicate that he is a free man); a. fr.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 25">Ex. R. s. 25</cite> (ref. to <he>ויסב</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 13:18">Ex. XIII, 18</cite>, a. <cite ref="U01278"><he>שלחן</he></cite>, <cite ref="Psalms 78:19">Ps. LXXVIII, 19</cite>) <he>הסַיבָּן תחת ענני וכ׳</he> he invited them to recline under the clouds of glory (v. <cite ref="O00562"><he>סִיגְמָטִין</he></cite>); a. e.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 14:1">Pesik. R. s. 14</cite> <he>עתיד אני להָסֵיב על עולמי וכ׳</he> I shall turn again to my world in mercy.

senses.gloss: to be transferred from tribe to tribe (Num. XXXVI, 7).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 112a">B. Bath. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>כבר הוּסַבָּה</he> the field had been transferred (before the division of the land); <he>שכבר הוסבה לא אמרינן</he> we do not adopt the argument that a transfer before the division made any difference (v. comment., a. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 4 a. 5 for Var. Lect.).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:4">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite>, v. supra.
